query: Review this error handler for our eSIM Plus partner integration: it does `if (res.status === 422) showFieldErrors(body.errors)` and `if (res.status === 404) return null`, and retries every failed request 3 times with backoff.
expected_behavior: Identifies that dispatch must be on the domain code, not the HTTP status
Explains both envelopes and that a 422 has no per-field errors map
Flags the blanket retry as unsafe for POST /phone-numbers
assertions: Mentions that one HTTP status carries several domain codes and lists at least two codes for 404 (e.g. 1307, 1311, 1321, 1324, 1325, 1329)
States that Envelope B (422/429) has no `code` and no per-field `errors` map, so `body.errors` is wrong
States that POST /phone-numbers is not idempotent and must not be auto-retried
Does not invent error codes outside 1301-1329, and does not use the retired 1316-1318, 1320 or 1328
